title: Trustee intake of a version-4 ballot record at a seat of either panel: admission over both panels with its membership proof, the share hash, decryption, the version-2 share receipt and its checks
generator: packages/crypto/scripts/intake-v4-vectors.py, an implementation of Decryption and intake (ballot version 4) and Share receipt (ballot version 4) with Python's integers and hashlib, reusing this folder's independent ballot-v4-records generator (elections, records, admission, membership signals), the share-encryption-v4 generator (encryption and decryption) and trustee-vectors.py's RFC 6979 P-256 ECDSA; membership proofs by packages/crypto/scripts/ballot-proofs.mjs, run outside the workspace with Semaphore 4.14.3's depth-32 circuit artifacts and snarkjs 0.7.5's fullProve, which checks that each proof's outputs equal the root and nullifier computed here; every pairing verdict is snarkjs's groth16.verify on the signals derived here from the record and the definition. The delivery-malformed cases are labelled by hand from the strict-decoding rules
